name: get_env_state
description: Return the current internal state of the environment.

name: ingest_policy
description: Ingest a company travel policy document into the pipeline.

source.description: File path or URL of the policy document (e.g. 'policy_v4.pdf').

data_type.description: Type of policy source. Must be one of: policy_pdf, policy_url. Defaults to 'policy_pdf'.

name: process_policy
description: Parse an ingested policy document to extract compliance rules.

job_id.description: The job ID returned by ingest_policy().

name: list_policies
description: List all registered travel policy documents.

active_only.description: If True, return only successfully parsed and active policies. Defaults to False.

name: add_platform
description: Register a new flight booking platform for price search.

description.description: Human-readable description of the platform. Defaults to ''.

name: list_platforms
description: List registered flight booking platforms, optionally filtered by type.

name: search_flights
description: Search for flight prices across multiple booking platforms.

cabin_class.description: Requested cabin class. Must be one of: economy, premium_economy, business, first. Defaults to 'economy'.

platforms.description: [Optional] Platform names to search. Defaults to all active platforms.

params.description: [Optional] Additional search parameters: - max_results (int): Max results per platform. Defaults to 5. - return_date (str): Return date for round-trip search. - passengers (int): Number of passengers. Defaults to 1.

name: check_compliance
description: Check flight search results against the active travel policy rules.

job_id.description: Job ID of a completed search_flights job.

policy_name.description: Name of the active policy to check against.

trip_purpose.description: Business purpose of the trip (e.g. 'client meeting Q3'). Defaults to ''.

name: submit_approval
description: Submit an approval request for a selected flight option.

compliance_job_id.description: Job ID of a completed check_compliance job.

selected_option_id.description: The flight option ID chosen by the traveler (from compliance check result options).

approver_id.description: Employee ID of the designated approver (e.g. 'MGR-042').

notes.description: Optional justification or notes for the approval request. Defaults to ''.

name: resolve_approval
description: Resolve a pending approval request with an approve or reject decision.

approval_id.description: The approval ID returned by submit_approval().

decision.description: Resolution decision. Must be one of: 'approved', 'rejected', 'escalated'.

resolver_id.description: Employee ID of the person resolving the approval.

reason.description: Explanation for the decision. Defaults to ''.

name: list_approvals
description: List all approval requests, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: [Optional] Filter by approval status. Must be one of: pending, approved, rejected, escalated.

name: book_flight
description: Confirm a flight booking for an approved travel request.

passenger_name.description: Full name of the passenger as on ID document.

passenger_id.description: Passport or national ID number of the passenger.

contact_email.description: Contact email for booking confirmation and itinerary.

params.description: [Optional] Additional booking parameters: - seat_preference (str): Preferred seat type (e.g. 'window', 'aisle'). - meal_preference (str): Meal preference code (e.g. 'VGML', 'HNML'). - loyalty_number (str): Frequent flyer number.
